title: [narrowed from org-isolation-on-trace-reads-is-enforced-by-neither-layer] Tenant isolation on trace reads is not enforce
description:
[narrowed from org-isolation-on-trace-reads-is-enforced-by-neither-layer] Tenant isolation on trace reads is not enforced by either of its two supposed layers. The application-level org_id filter is silently dropped by the query engine, and the database PERMISSIONS layer that is documented as the real control is bypassed because the service connects as root. Reproduced 2026-09-11 against the live database, using the exact query shape activity-api emits.
